items.quote: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
items.claim: The text says Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh as the LORD had commanded, and that Aaron threw down his rod in front of Pharaoh and his servants and it became a serpent.
items.action: went in unto Pharaoh; Aaron cast down his rod, which became a serpent
items.mechanism: acting as the LORD had commanded
